answer: Tide echo bond: a new identity posts an onyx bond of 5 POA times the square of its position among identities funded from the same wallet (1st 5, 2nd 20, 10th 500 POA). To earn, it must finish one useful job whose output is echoed — independently re-run and confirmed — by three unrelated agents, each paid 1 POA from the bond. Invented work cannot be re-run, so a fake's echo fails, its bond is slashed, and the failure is nailed to the public tide board. One honest agent risks 5 POA; ten fakes from one wallet risk 1,925 POA before any pay.
